en: Xcode’s Metal Toolchain is missing. Click “Download” to install it (about 1 GB); checks rerun automatically.

source: 准备游戏需要 Xcode 的 Metal 编译组件；先安装 Xcode。
en: Preparing games needs Xcode’s Metal Toolchain. Install Xcode first.

source: 没找到完整的 Xcode：点「去 App Store 安装」，装好打开一次后回来点重新检查；S2Arm 会自动找到它。
en: Full Xcode not found. Click “Get from App Store”, open it once after installing, then click Check Again; S2Arm finds it automatically.

en: Packing

en: Pack game

source: 打包完成，可以启动了。
en: Packing finished. Ready to launch.

source: 添加游戏文件夹或 NSP / XCI，放进来自动打包（⌘O）
en: Add a game folder or NSP / XCI files; they pack automatically (⌘O)

source:
把游戏拖到这里，或点下面的按钮。
放进来就自动打包，好了点启动。
en:
Drag games here or click the button below.
They pack automatically; launch when ready.

source: 先放入你的 prod.keys 和游戏。
en: Start by adding your prod.keys and games.

source: 开始
en: Start

source: S2Arm 将尝试通用构建；打包成功不代表游戏已通过兼容性验证。
en: S2Arm will try a generic build; packing successfully does not mean the game passed compatibility checks.

source: 新增内容或引擎更新还没重新打包；启动将使用上次成功版本。
en: New content or engine updates aren’t packed yet; launching uses the last successful build.

source: 下次启动生效，无需重新打包。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Takes effect next launch; no repacking needed. The game must support the language.

source: 重新打包
en: Pack again

source: 打包条件未满足
en: Packing requirements not met

source: 游戏一款一款依次打包；打包时可以继续添加游戏、改按键。
en: Games pack one at a time; you can keep adding games and editing controls meanwhile.

source: 放进来的游戏会自动打包，进度在这里看。
en: Games you add pack automatically; follow progress here.

source: 密钥只需导入一次，所有游戏共用；只保存在本机，不随诊断包导出。添加的游戏放进来就自动打包，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。
en: Keys are imported once and shared by all games; they stay on this Mac and are never included in diagnostics. Added games pack automatically; updates and DLC merge by version.

source: 打包前检查应用内置组件和 Xcode；启动已打包的游戏只检查运行所需组件。
en: Packing checks bundled components and Xcode; launching packed games only checks what running needs.

source: S2Arm 引擎、Python 及其依赖、.NET 运行时、打包工具和共享字体都随应用内置。打包游戏需要完整 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件（缺了在检测项旁一键处理），启动已打包的游戏不需要 Xcode。玩家只需放入 prod.keys 和游戏（本体、更新、DLC）。
en: The S2Arm engine, Python and its dependencies, the .NET runtime, packing tools and shared fonts are all bundled. Packing games needs full Xcode and its Metal Toolchain (fix with one click next to the check); launching packed games does not. Just add your prod.keys and games (base, updates, DLC).

source: 与界面语言独立；可在游戏详情中单独设置启动语言。下次启动生效，无需重新打包或导入固件。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Independent of the interface language; set a per-game launch language in game details. Takes effect next launch; no repacking or firmware import needed. The game must support the language.

source: 已打包的游戏可以启动，打包环境还需修复
en: Packed games can launch; the packing environment still needs fixing

source: S2Arm、Python、.NET 和共享字体随应用内置。打包还需要 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件，缺了在检测项旁一键处理；玩家只需放入密钥和游戏。
en: S2Arm, Python, .NET and shared fonts are bundled. Packing also needs Xcode and its Metal Toolchain; fix with one click next to the check. Just add your keys and games.

source: S2Arm 引擎随应用内置，包含 Mac 宿主、NSP/XCI 读取器和游戏打包工具。玩家数据与构建缓存独立保存。
en: The S2Arm engine is bundled: the Mac host, NSP/XCI reader and game packing tools. Player data and build caches are stored separately.

source: 读不出这个游戏：你的 prod.keys 解不开它。多半是密钥太旧（导出密钥的 Switch 系统版本比游戏要求的低），请把 Switch 更新到最新系统后重新导出 prod.keys，到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入，再放一次游戏。如果密钥是新的，可能是游戏文件不完整，请重新复制或下载后再试。
en: Can’t read this game: your prod.keys can’t decrypt it. Most likely the keys are too old (dumped from a Switch on a lower system version than the game needs). Update your Switch to the latest system, dump prod.keys again, re-import them in Settings → Player keys, then add the game again. If your keys are new, the game file may be incomplete; copy or download it again.

source: 缺游戏本体：只放了更新或 DLC，把本体的 NSP / XCI 也放进来
en: Base game missing: only an update or DLC was added. Add the base game’s NSP / XCI too.

source: 这款游戏是 32 位程序，S2Arm 暂时只支持 64 位游戏，打不了包
en: This game is a 32-bit program. S2Arm only supports 64-bit games for now, so it can’t be packed.

source: 拉回 iPhone 诊断
en: Pull iPhone diagnostics

source: 拉回 iPhone 诊断…
en: Pull iPhone Diagnostics…

source: 用数据线连上 iPhone / iPad 并解锁，S2Arm 会把手机上各游戏的诊断包和运行日志拉回这台 Mac（不拉存档和游戏文件）。
en: Connect your iPhone / iPad with a cable and unlock it. S2Arm pulls each game’s diagnostics and run logs to this Mac (never saves or game files).

source: 已拉回 {0} 个游戏的诊断，在访达里打开了。
en: Pulled diagnostics for {0} game(s) and opened them in Finder.

source: 没找到已连接的 iPhone / iPad：用数据线连上并解锁，在手机上点「信任这台电脑」，再试一次。
en: No connected iPhone / iPad found. Connect it with a cable, unlock it, tap “Trust This Computer”, then try again.

source: 连着的设备上没找到 S2Arm 打的游戏 App，或者这些 App 还没运行过、没有日志。
en: No S2Arm game apps found on the connected device, or they haven’t run yet and have no logs.

en: Install

en: Needed to pack for iPhone

source: 打包和运行互斥，请等当前任务结束。
en: Packing and running can’t happen at the same time. Wait for the current task to finish.

source: iPhone 包已出好，在访达里打开了。按装机步骤用 AltStore 装到手机，再把「资源包」文件夹拷进去。
en: The iPhone package is ready and open in Finder. Follow the install steps to install it with AltStore, then copy the resource pack folder into the app.

source: .NET SDK 已安装。
en: .NET SDK installed.

source: 打 iPhone 包需要 .NET 10 SDK：点「一键安装」，从微软官方下载装到你的用户目录（约 300 MB，不要管理员密码）。只在 Mac 上玩不需要它。
en: Packing for iPhone needs the .NET 10 SDK. Click “Install” to download it from Microsoft into your user folder (about 300 MB, no admin password). Not needed to play on Mac.

source: 打 iPhone 包需要 .NET SDK：到「设置」的环境检查里点「一键安装」，装好后再点「打 iPhone 包」。
en: Packing for iPhone needs the .NET SDK. Click “Install” in Settings’ environment checks, then click “Pack for iPhone” again.

source: 应用内置引擎太旧，没有打 iPhone 包的工具，请安装最新版 S2Arm。
en: The bundled engine is too old to pack for iPhone. Install the latest S2Arm.

source: 一键出包结束了，但没找到 IPA，请查看日志。
en: Packing finished but no IPA was found. Check the logs.

en: Identifying game

source: 改写、系统数据、着色器全量预编
en: Rewriting, system data and precompiling all shaders

source: 编 App、签名、打资源包
en: Building app, signing and packing resources

en: Preparing game files

source: 下载 .NET 安装脚本
en: Downloading .NET installer

source: 下载并安装 .NET 10 SDK（约 300 MB）
en: Downloading and installing .NET 10 SDK (about 300 MB)

source: 把 Switch 的 ARM 程序改写成能在苹果设备上直接运行的形式。
en: Rewrite the Switch ARM program so it runs natively on Apple devices.

en: The package is not tied to a model: it installs on any iPhone / iPad with iOS 18 or later, and shaders are compiled once on the device the first time you play. The device here is only used for the memory-window hint.

en: Use with AI

en: Allow AI to operate S2Arm

source: 打开后，这台 Mac 上的 AI 助手（比如 Claude Code）可以替你放密钥、放游戏、打包、打 iPhone 包、看失败原因并重试。只在本机，别的设备连不进来。
en: When on, an AI assistant on this Mac (such as Claude Code) can add keys and games, pack, build iPhone packages, read why something failed and retry for you. Local only; other devices cannot connect.

en: Copy instructions for AI

en: Copied. Paste it to your AI assistant.

source: 规则：只在这台 Mac 上操作；不要上传、复制或打印 prod.keys 和游戏文件；遇到失败先看任务里的错误码和恢复建议再重试。
en: Rules: work only on this Mac; never upload, copy or print prod.keys or game files; when something fails, read the task's error code and recovery suggestion before retrying.

source: 无法解密或校验这个游戏；可能是密钥不匹配，也可能是游戏文件不完整。
en: The game could not be decrypted or verified. The keys may not match, or the game files may be incomplete.

source: 任务所在磁盘空间不足。
en: The task disk has insufficient space.

source: 文件或目录不可访问或不可写。
en: A file or folder cannot be accessed or written.

source: 任务所需的文件或目录不存在。
en: A file or folder required by the task does not exist.

source: 任务所需的工具无法启动：{0}
en: A tool required by the task could not start: {0}

source: 所选游戏文件或文件夹不存在。
en: The selected game file or folder does not exist.

source: 在「设置 → 玩家密钥」导入自行导出的 prod.keys，然后重新导入游戏。
en: Import your own prod.keys in Settings → Player keys, then import the game again.

source: 重新选择完整的 prod.keys 文本文件，不要手工补写密钥值；原有密钥保持不变。
en: Select a complete prod.keys text file again. Do not fill in key values by hand; your existing keys are kept.

source: 核对自行导出的密钥是否匹配游戏所需版本，并检查游戏文件完整性，然后重新导入；此错误不能单独确定是密钥还是文件问题。
en: Check that your exported keys match the game requirements and verify the game files, then import again. This error alone cannot distinguish a key mismatch from damaged files.

source: 选择 NSP、XCI 文件或包含它们的文件夹，然后重新导入。
en: Select an NSP or XCI file, or a folder containing them, then import again.

source: 确认所选文件夹包含 NSP 或 XCI 文件，再重新导入。
en: Check that the selected folder contains NSP or XCI files, then import again.

source: 重新连接存储磁盘，确认文件仍在原位置且可读取；托管游戏文件缺失时，请从原始文件重新导入。
en: Reconnect the storage drive and check that the files are still readable at their original locations. Import missing managed game files again from your originals.

source: 将对应的游戏本体 NSP 或 XCI 一并导入；仅更新或 DLC 不能单独打包。
en: Import the matching base-game NSP or XCI as well. An update or DLC alone cannot be packaged.

source: 这款游戏的 32 位 ARM 程序暂不支持，重试无法解决；请选择 64 位 ARM 游戏。
en: 32-bit ARM game programs are not supported. Retrying will not fix this; choose a 64-bit ARM game.

source: 检查原始游戏文件是否完整，重新导入后再试；仍失败时复制错误摘要并保留对应日志。
en: Check that the original game files are complete, then import and retry. If it still fails, copy the error summary and keep the task log.

source: 释放任务所在磁盘的空间，检查游戏库和应用数据所在磁盘后重试；不要删除存档或上次成功的运行版本。
en: Free space on the task disk. Check both the game-library and app-data disks before retrying; keep your saves and last working release.

source: 检查文件和目录权限；若位于桌面、文稿、下载或外接磁盘，请在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 文件与文件夹」允许 S2Arm 访问，再重试。
en: Check file and folder permissions. For Desktop, Documents, Downloads or external drives, allow S2Arm access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders, then retry.

source: 当前路径需要 Apple Silicon Mac，请换用支持的设备；重试不会改变硬件兼容性。
en: This path requires an Apple Silicon Mac. Use a supported device; retrying cannot change hardware compatibility.

source: 当前游戏路径需要 macOS 15 或更新版本；在支持的系统上重新检查环境后再试。
en: The current game path requires macOS 15 or later. Recheck the environment on a supported system, then retry.

source: 在设置中检查所选 Xcode 是否完整且包含所需平台 SDK，打开 Xcode 完成设置后重新检查环境。
en: In Settings, check that the selected Xcode is complete and includes the required platform SDK. Open Xcode to finish setup, then recheck the environment.

source: 打开所选 Xcode，同意许可并完成首次设置，返回 S2Arm 重新检查环境。
en: Open the selected Xcode, accept its license and finish initial setup, then return to S2Arm and recheck the environment.

source: 开发模式需要 .NET 10 SDK；完整应用请重新安装以恢复内置运行时，然后重新检查环境。
en: Development mode needs the .NET 10 SDK. For the complete app, reinstall it to restore the bundled runtime, then recheck the environment.

source: 在「设置」的环境检查中安装 .NET 10 SDK，完成后重新检查，再打 iPhone 包。
en: Install the .NET 10 SDK from the environment checks in Settings, recheck, then generate the iPhone package again.

source: 开发模式请在设置中重新准备引擎工具；完整应用请重新安装，然后重新导入游戏。
en: In development mode, prepare the engine tools again in Settings. For the complete app, reinstall it, then import the game again.

source: 重新选择完整的 S2Arm 源码目录；使用完整应用时，请重新安装应用后检查环境。
en: Select a complete S2Arm source directory. For the complete app, reinstall it and recheck the environment.

source: 检查本任务日志中缺少的工具；开发模式补齐构建依赖，完整应用则重新安装，然后重试。
en: Check the task log for the missing tool. Install the build dependency in development mode, or reinstall the complete app, then retry.

source: 重新打包这款游戏以恢复完整运行文件；保留原有存档，打包成功后再启动。
en: Package this game again to restore complete runtime files. Keep your saves, then launch after packaging succeeds.

source: 检查游戏输入
en: Check game inputs

source: 检查导入文件
en: Check import files

source: 先把 Switch 更新到最新系统，重新导出 prod.keys，到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入，再放一次游戏；如果密钥已是新的，请检查游戏文件是否完整，重新复制后再试。
en: Update your Switch to the latest system, export prod.keys again, import it in Settings → Player keys, then add the game again. If your keys are already current, check that the game files are complete and copy them again before retrying.

source: 去 App Store 安装 Xcode，装好打开一次并完成必要组件安装，回来点「重新检查」。
en: Install Xcode from the App Store, open it once and finish installing its required components, then return and click Check again.

source: 打开 Xcode，同意许可并完成首次设置，回来点「重新检查」。
en: Open Xcode, accept the license and finish initial setup, then return and click Check again.

source: 重新安装完整的 S2Arm，恢复内置运行时后点「重新检查」。
en: Reinstall the complete S2Arm app to restore its bundled runtime, then click Check again.

source: 重新安装完整的 S2Arm，然后重新导入游戏。
en: Reinstall the complete S2Arm app, then import the game again.

source: 重新安装完整的 S2Arm，然后点「重新检查」。
en: Reinstall the complete S2Arm app, then click Check again.

source: 重新安装完整的 S2Arm，点「重新检查」后重试。
en: Reinstall the complete S2Arm app, click Check again, then retry.

source: 用数据线连上 iPhone / iPad，或在「跨平台编译 → iOS」中选机型和系统版本；连着多台不同目标时，请先选一台。
en: Connect your iPhone or iPad with a cable, or select its model and system version in Cross-platform builds → iOS. If multiple different targets are connected, select one first.

source: 这台设备的 GPU 或系统不在当前支持范围内，重试无法解决；需要 A14 / M1 或更新芯片及 iOS / iPadOS 18 或更新系统。
en: This device GPU or system is outside the supported range, so retrying will not help. An A14 / M1 or newer chip and iOS / iPadOS 18 or later are required.

source: 把 Xcode 更新到最新版，装好打开一次，回来点「重新检查」，再打 iPhone 包。
en: Update Xcode to the latest version and open it once, then return, click Check again and generate the iPhone package again.

source: 安装 .NET 10 SDK，然后点「重新检查」。
en: Install the .NET 10 SDK, then click Check again.

source: 在设置中重新准备引擎工具，然后重新导入游戏。
en: Prepare the engine tools again in Settings, then import the game again.

source: 重新选择完整的 S2Arm 源码目录，然后点「重新检查」。
en: Select a complete S2Arm source directory, then click Check again.

source: 查看任务日志中缺少的工具，补齐构建依赖后重试。
en: Check the task log for the missing tool, install the build dependency, then retry.

source: 存档恢复已完成。
en: Save restoration completed.

source: 存档已恢复，事务清理尚未完成。原副本已保留，请重新检查。
en: The save was restored, but transaction cleanup is unfinished. The original copy was retained. Check again.

source: 保留恢复前副本
en: Preserving the previous save

source: 先检查备份，再确认恢复。错误游戏、用户、版本或损坏的备份会被拒绝。
en: Check a backup before confirming restoration. Backups for another game, user or version, and damaged backups, are rejected.

en: A backup with this name already exists. Choose a new filename.

source: 备份与当前游戏版本或更新、DLC 组合不符，已拒绝恢复。
en: The backup does not match the current game version, update or DLC selection. Restoration was refused.

source: 备份失败，原存档未修改。请检查目录、权限和存档完整性。

en: This backup belongs to another game. Restoration was refused.

source: 在 Mac 上装 AltServer，再用它把 AltStore 装到 iPhone（按 altstore.io 官网说明）。推荐 AltStore Classic 2.2 或更新；不要用 SideStore 0.7.0，它会丢掉「提高内存上限」权限，大型游戏会打不开。

source: iPhone 上打开「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」，打开后按提示重启。
en: On your iPhone, turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode, then restart when asked.

source: 把出好的 .ipa 用隔空投送或「文件」App 传到 iPhone，在 AltStore「我的 App」里点左上角「+」选它，按提示登录 Apple ID 完成安装。免费账号就可以。
en: Send the .ipa to your iPhone with AirDrop or the Files app. In AltStore, open My Apps, tap + at the top left, choose it and sign in with your Apple ID to install. A free account works.

source: 用数据线连上 iPhone，打开访达，左边选你的 iPhone →「文件」→ 找到这款游戏的 App，把同一文件夹里的整个「资源包」文件夹拖到它上面。

source: 打开游戏：第一次会先导入游戏资源，保持前台、不要锁屏，几分钟；导入完会自动进入游戏。

source: 免费 Apple ID 签的 App 7 天过期：Mac 上开着 AltServer、和 iPhone 在同一个 Wi-Fi 下会自动续签；过期了在 AltStore 点「刷新全部」，不用重新拷资源包。

source: 这条路还在真机验证，装不上或打不开时请改用下面的 AltStore。
en: This path is still being verified on real devices. If it fails to install or the game won't open, use AltStore below.

source: 用数据线连上 iPhone 并解锁，在手机上点「信任」；第一次还要在「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」打开开发者模式，按提示重启。
en: Connect your iPhone with a cable, unlock it and tap “Trust”; the first time, also turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode and restart when asked.

source: 用数据线连上 iPhone，一键装好：用你在 Xcode 里登录的 Apple ID 签名，资源包一起拷进去
en: Connect your iPhone and install in one click: signed with the Apple ID you use in Xcode, resource pack included

source: 装到 iPhone
en: Install on iPhone

source: 。打开游戏：第一次会先导入游戏资源（几分钟），保持在前台、别锁屏，导入完会自动进入游戏。免费 Apple ID 签的 App 7 天过期，到时连上再点一次「装到 iPhone」。
en: . Open the game: the first launch imports the game resources (a few minutes). Keep it in the foreground and the screen unlocked; the game starts by itself when the import finishes. Apps signed with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days — connect and click “Install on iPhone” again.

source: 会删除这款游戏的 iPhone 包（IPA）、资源包、出包中间产物和缓存，并从游戏库移除；存档和原始游戏文件保留。
en: This deletes the game's iPhone package (IPA), resource pack, build intermediates and caches, and removes it from the library. Saves and original game files are kept.

source: 检查当前阶段的配置推导错误，保留原始游戏输入；更新完整引擎后重新准备，仍失败时反馈错误摘要。
en: Check the configuration inference error and keep the original input. Update the complete engine and prepare again; report the error summary if it persists.

source: 检查着色器抽取的具体错误；确认游戏输入完整且版本一致，重新准备后仍失败时反馈摘要。
en: Check the shader extraction error. Confirm complete, matching game inputs, prepare again, and report the summary if it persists.

source: 保留着色器翻译错误摘要并更新完整引擎后重试；翻译未支持的输入不能通过重新签名解决。
en: Keep the shader translation error summary and update the complete engine before retrying. Re-signing cannot fix unsupported shader input.

source: 按编译错误检查 Xcode、Metal 组件和 .NET SDK；完成环境检查后重试，保留原有成功版本与存档。
en: Check Xcode, Metal components, and the .NET SDK against the compiler error. Recheck the environment and retry; keep the previous working version and saves.

source: 检查程序改写的首个错误；保留原始游戏文件，更新完整引擎后重试，仍失败时反馈摘要。
en: Check the first program rewriting error. Keep the original game files, update the complete engine, and report the summary if retrying fails.

source: 检查资源准备错误和输入目录权限，确认资源完整后重新准备；不要删除存档或上次成功的包。
en: Check resource preparation errors and input permissions, then prepare complete resources again. Do not delete saves or the last successful package.

source: 这一步的失败还没归类：错误摘要里有失败阶段、退出码和错误原文，点「复制错误摘要」发给我们。
en: This failure is not classified yet: the error summary has the failed stage, exit code and error text. Click "Copy error summary" and send it to us.

source: 磁盘空间不够：准备这个游戏需要更多空余空间。
en: Not enough disk space. Preparing this game needs more free space.

source: 改写失败：这款游戏有一处程序代码暂不支持。
en: Rewriting failed. This game has a code pattern that is not yet supported.

source: 着色器编译暂不支持：这款游戏的着色器编译目前只能在 Mac 上完成。
en: Shader compilation not available. Shader compilation for this game is currently only available on Mac.

source: 缺少 Metal 组件：编着色器要用的 Metal 组件没装上。
en: Metal not available. The Metal component needed for shader compilation is not installed.

source: 在设置里点「iOS 平台组件」的「一键下载」（苹果官方，约 8 GB），下完自动重新检查后重试；也可以打开 Xcode → 设置 → Components 装上与 Xcode 配套的 iOS 平台。
en: In Settings, click Download next to “iOS Platform Components” (from Apple, about 8 GB); it rechecks automatically when done, then try again. You can also open Xcode → Settings → Components and install the iOS platform that matches your Xcode.

source: 缺少 iOS 平台组件：Xcode 的 iOS 平台还没装，打不了 iPhone 包。
en: iOS Platform Components not installed: Xcode's iOS platform is not installed, so iPhone packages cannot be built.

source: iOS 平台组件
en: iOS Platform Components

source: 下载 iOS 平台组件
en: Download iOS Platform Components

source: iOS 平台组件已安装。
en: iOS Platform Components installed.

source: 下载 Xcode 的 iOS 平台组件（约 8 GB）
en: Downloading Xcode's iOS Platform Components (about 8 GB)

source: 已装 Xcode 的 iOS {0} 平台组件。
en: Xcode's iOS {0} Platform Components are installed.

source: Xcode 的 iOS {0} 平台组件已经下载，但还没注册就绪：点「重新检查」再看一遍；不用重复下载（约 8 GB）。只在 Mac 上玩不需要它。
en: Xcode's iOS {0} Platform Components are downloaded but not registered yet: click Check again. There is no need to download the ~8 GB package again. Not needed if you only play on this Mac.

source: Xcode 的 iOS {0} 平台组件还没装（新装或刚升级的 Xcode 要另下）：打 iPhone 包、装到 iPhone 都要用它。点「一键下载」自动安装（苹果官方，约 8 GB，要些时间），下完自动重新检查。只在 Mac 上玩不需要它。
en: Xcode's iOS {0} Platform Components are not installed (a new or newly upgraded Xcode installs them separately): building iPhone packages and installing to iPhone need them. Click Download to install them automatically (from Apple, about 8 GB; it takes a while); the check runs again when it finishes. Not needed if you only play on this Mac.

source: 已下载 iOS 平台组件，但复查仍未通过。请在「设置 → 环境检查」查看 iOS 平台一项的说明。
en: The iOS platform was downloaded, but the recheck still failed. See the iOS platform item in Settings → Environment Check.

source: iOS 平台组件已经下载，只是还没注册到模拟器：点「重新检查」再试；不用重复下载（约 8 GB）。还不行就在 Xcode → 设置 → Components 里确认这一项，或重启这台 Mac 后再点「重新检查」。
en: The iOS platform is downloaded but not registered with the simulator yet: click Check again; there is no need to download the ~8 GB package again. If that does not help, check this item in Xcode → Settings → Components, or restart this Mac and check again.

source: 一键下载（约 8 GB）
en: Download (about 8 GB)

source: 缺少工具：这条链上有个工具没装。
en: Tool missing. A tool in this pipeline is not installed.

source: 文件内容不对：文件结构校验没通过，可能没下完整。
en: Content rejected. The file structure did not validate; the copy may be incomplete.

source: 签名没成：用你的 Apple ID 给这台 iPhone 签名没成功。
en: Signing failed. Signing for this iPhone with your Apple ID did not succeed.

source: 配置推导失败。
en: Configuration inference failed.

source: 着色器抽取失败。
en: Shader extraction failed.

source: 编译失败。
en: Compilation failed.

source: 程序改写失败。
en: Program rewriting failed.

source: 资源准备失败。
en: Resource preparation failed.

source: 设备安装失败。
en: Device installation failed.

source: 出包未完成。
en: Packaging incomplete.

source: 按安装错误检查设备连接与包的有效性；保持手机解锁后重试，保留原 App 和存档。
en: Check the device connection and package validity against the install error. Retry with the phone unlocked; keep the original app and saves.

source: 解锁手机并检查数据线及剩余空间后重试资源传输；保留已有 App、存档和电脑上的资源包。
en: Unlock the phone and check the cable and free space, then retry the resource transfer. Keep the app, saves, and local resource package.

source: 在 iPhone「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」按系统提示开启开发者模式，再重新安装。
en: Enable Developer Mode in iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security following the system instructions, then retry installation.

source: 重新用数据线连接并解锁 iPhone，在手机上确认「信任此电脑」，然后重新检查设备并安装。
en: Reconnect the iPhone by cable, unlock it, and confirm Trust This Computer. Recheck the device and install again.

source: 开发描述文件已过期；在 Xcode 重新登录签名账号、重新申请描述文件并签名安装，保留原 App 存档。
en: The provisioning profile expired. Sign in to the signing account in Xcode, renew the profile, and re-sign and install while keeping existing saves.

source: 已完成的安装包可以保留；检查磁盘余量与缓存目录权限后再清理缓存，不要删除游戏或存档。
en: Keep the completed package. Check free disk space and cache directory permissions before retrying cache cleanup; do not delete games or saves.

source: 当前阶段已超时；检查该阶段日志和设备连接，确认原因后重试，不要同时重复启动同一任务。
en: This stage timed out. Check its log and device connection before retrying; do not start duplicate tasks.

source: 重新选择可识别的目标机型与系统版本，或连接并解锁目标设备后重新检查。
en: Select a recognized target model and OS version, or connect and unlock the target device and recheck.

source: 任务缺少请求记录，无法安全接续；返回游戏库重新发起操作，不要手工修改任务记录。
en: The request record is missing, so this task cannot be safely resumed. Start again from the library without editing job records.

source: 此进程不属于当前任务，未发送停止信号；返回任务列表检查目标任务，不要强行结束其他进程。
en: This process does not belong to the task, so no stop signal was sent. Check the task list rather than terminating another process.

source: 原任务进程已经结束，当前进程号属于另一进程；刷新任务列表，不要按旧进程号停止任务。
en: The original task ended and its process ID was reused. Refresh the task list; do not stop a task using the old process ID.

source: 当前私有目录里没有这条任务；刷新任务列表并确认使用原游戏库，必要时重新发起操作。
en: This task is not in the current private directory. Refresh the task list and check the original library, or start a new operation.

source: 任务记录写入失败；检查磁盘空间和目录权限，保留产物与日志，恢复可写后重新检查任务。
en: The job record could not be written. Check disk space and directory permissions; keep artifacts and logs and recheck once writable.

source: 存档备份未完成，原存档保持不动；检查备份目录权限与空间后重新备份。
en: The save backup did not complete; the original save is unchanged. Check backup permissions and space and retry.

source: 备份期间存档发生变化；先正常退出游戏，再重新检查并备份存档。
en: The save changed during backup. Exit the game normally, then check and back up again.

source: 存档恢复已完成但事务清理未完成；保留备份和事务记录，检查目录权限后再检查恢复状态。
en: The save was restored but transaction cleanup is incomplete. Keep backups and transaction records, check permissions, and recheck recovery status.

source: 选择游戏库和应用私有目录之外、可写且有足够空间的备份目的地。
en: Choose a writable backup destination outside the game library and private app directory with sufficient space.

source: 当前没有可备份的存档；先在游戏中正常保存并退出，再重新检查。
en: There is no save to back up. Save in the game, exit normally, and check again.

source: 目标备份已经存在；选择新文件名或新目录，不要覆盖已有备份。
en: The backup destination already exists. Choose a new file name or directory instead of overwriting it.

source: 存档缺少有效的游戏程序号；重新选择原始备份，不要手工改写存档元数据。
en: The save has no valid game title ID. Select the original backup without manually editing its metadata.

source: 这份文件不是可识别的存档备份；重新选择由 S2Arm 导出的完整备份。
en: This file is not a recognized save backup. Select a complete backup exported by S2Arm.

source: 这款游戏尚未建立存档目录；先启动游戏并正常保存退出，再恢复备份。
en: This game has no save directory yet. Start it, save and exit normally, then restore the backup.

source: 存档回退没完成：事务记录与副本都保留着。可以先在存档页备份当前存档；确认可能丢掉没做完的导入 / 恢复后，可选「仍要启动」。不要删除事务目录。
en: The save rollback did not finish: the transaction record and copies are kept. You can back up the current saves on the Saves page first; after confirming you may lose the unfinished import / restore, you can choose “Launch anyway”. Do not delete the transaction folder.

source: 已按你的确认跳过存档回退启动游戏；事务记录保留，下次启动会再试恢复。
en: Launched the game skipping the save rollback as you confirmed; the record is kept and recovery is retried on the next launch.

source: 释放备份目的地的磁盘空间后重试；不要删除原存档或唯一的备份。
en: Free space at the backup destination and retry. Do not delete the original save or the only backup.

source: 存档路径含符号链接或不安全目录；选择普通目录中的完整备份，不要绕过路径保护。
en: The save path contains a symbolic link or unsafe directory. Select a complete backup in a regular directory without bypassing path protection.

source: 存档用户信息缺失或无效；重新选择游戏用户与原始备份，不要修改用户标识兜底。
en: The save user information is missing or invalid. Select the game user and original backup without substituting user IDs.

source: 备份与当前游戏版本或 DLC 不一致；使用匹配版本的游戏和备份后重试。
en: The backup does not match the game version or DLC. Retry with matching game inputs and backup.

source: 这份备份属于另一款游戏；回到对应游戏恢复，或选择当前游戏的备份。
en: This backup belongs to another game. Restore it in the matching game or select a backup for this game.

source: 这份备份属于另一用户；选择对应用户或该用户自己的备份后重试。
en: This backup belongs to another user. Select the matching user or their own backup and retry.

source: 免费 Apple ID 每台设备最多同时装 3 个自签 App、每 7 天最多注册 10 个包名：在 iPhone 上长按删掉一个不再玩的自签 App 后重试；包名额度用完则等 7 天恢复；或改用付费 Apple 开发者账号（没有这两个上限）。
en: A free Apple ID allows 3 self-signed apps per device and 10 App IDs per 7 days. Delete a self-signed app you no longer play from the iPhone home screen and retry; if the App ID quota is used up, wait 7 days for it to reset; or use a paid Apple Developer account, which has neither limit.

source: 打开 Xcode →「设置」→「账户」，点「+」登录你的 Apple ID（免费的就可以），再点一次「装到 iPhone」；不想登录 Xcode 也可以改用 AltStore 安装。
en: Open Xcode → Settings → Accounts, sign in with your Apple ID (a free account works), then retry installation. AltStore is also an installation option.

source: 用数据线连上要装的那台 iPhone 并解锁，在手机上点「信任」；第一次还要在「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」打开开发者模式，然后再试。
en: Connect the target iPhone by cable, unlock it, and tap Trust. First enable Developer Mode under Settings → Privacy & Security, then retry.

source: 查看本任务日志里签名那一步的报错；确认 Xcode 能用你的账号给这台 iPhone 签名，或改用 AltStore 安装。
en: Check the signing error in the job log. Confirm that Xcode can sign for this iPhone with your account, or install with AltStore.

source: 解锁这台 iPhone（保持亮屏、停在主屏幕），再点一次「装到 iPhone」；装机过程中别锁屏。
en: Unlock the iPhone and keep it awake on the Home Screen, then retry installation. Do not lock it during installation.

source: 本体已出好，照常安装即可；没解出的追加内容不在包里，游戏里用不到那部分内容。请导出诊断反馈，解码支持后重新打包即可带上。
en: The base game was packaged and can be installed as usual; the add-on content that could not be extracted is not in the package, so that content is unavailable in game. Please export a diagnostic report; repackage once decoding is supported to include it.

source: 已改从解包目录准备，本次照常完成，只是多花一些时间；游戏库放在 APFS 格式的磁盘上（Mac 内置盘或格式化为 APFS 的外接盘）时，各平台导出可以共用已准备好的游戏数据。
en: Preparation continued from the unpacked game data, so this export still finishes, only a little slower. When the game library is on an APFS disk (the Mac's internal disk or an external disk formatted as APFS), exports for different platforms can share the prepared game data.

source: 用 Xcode（免费 Apple ID 即可）或 AltStore Classic v2.3 重新签名安装这款游戏；SideStore 0.7.0 免费账号重签会丢这项权限。已装的也可以用 GetMoreRam 给 App ID 补上权限后重装。
en: Re-sign with Xcode (a free Apple ID works) or AltStore Classic v2.3. SideStore 0.7.0 free signing loses this entitlement; GetMoreRam can repair the App ID before reinstalling.

source: 资源包已经在手机上，不用重推：在 iPhone 上打开 S2Arm，选这款游戏，保持在前台别锁屏，等它导入完就能玩。
en: The resource pack is already on your iPhone, so there is no need to send it again. Open S2Arm on your iPhone, choose this game, keep it in the foreground with the screen on, and it will be ready once the import finishes.

source: 换一根支持 USB 3 的 USB-C 数据线，直接插 Mac 上的 USB-C / 雷雳口（不经扩展坞、集线器、显示器上的口），再装下一款；iPhone 15 Pro 及更新的 Pro 机型才支持 USB 3，其它机型只能 USB 2.0。
en: Use a USB 3 data cable directly in a Mac USB-C or Thunderbolt port without a hub or display. Only iPhone 15 Pro and newer Pro models support USB 3; other models use USB 2.0.

source: 装好的包能用；要在 iPhone Duo 等新机型上铺满全屏，把 Xcode 更新到不低于这台 iPhone 系统大版本的版本（如 iOS 27 用 Xcode 27），在启动器里选它后重新打 iPhone 包再装。
en: The installed app works. To fill the screen on newer models such as iPhone Duo, update Xcode to at least the iPhone's iOS major version (for iOS 27, Xcode 27), select it in the launcher, then rebuild and reinstall the iPhone package.

en: A default library is created automatically; you can change its location. Import your keys, then add games. Keys are shared across games, stored privately on this Mac and excluded from diagnostics.

en: Added games are prepared automatically; updates and DLC are merged by version. Launch a game when preparation finishes.

Drag games here or click the button below.

source: S2Arm 将尝试通用构建；编译成功不代表游戏已通过兼容性验证。
en: S2Arm will try a generic build; compiling successfully does not mean the game passed compatibility checks.

source: 新增内容或引擎更新还没重新编译；启动将使用上次成功版本。
en: New content or engine updates aren’t compiled yet; launching uses the last successful build.

source: 下次启动生效，无需重新编译。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Takes effect next launch; no repacking needed. The game must support the language.

source: 重新编译
en: Pack again

source: 编译条件未满足
en: Compiling requirements not met

source: 游戏一款一款依次编译；编译时可以继续添加游戏、改按键。
en: Games pack one at a time; you can keep adding games and editing controls meanwhile.

source: 放进来的游戏会自动编译，进度在这里看。
en: Games you add pack automatically; follow progress here.

source: 密钥只需导入一次，所有游戏共用；只保存在本机，不随诊断包导出。添加的游戏放进来就自动编译，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。
en: Keys are imported once and shared by all games; they stay on this Mac and are never included in diagnostics. Added games pack automatically; updates and DLC merge by version.

source: 编译前检查应用内置组件和 Xcode；启动已编译的游戏只检查运行所需组件。
en: Compiling checks bundled components and Xcode; launching compiled games only checks what running needs.

source: S2Arm 引擎、Python 及其依赖、.NET 运行时、编译工具和共享字体都随应用内置。编译游戏需要完整 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件（缺了在检测项旁一键处理），启动已编译的游戏不需要 Xcode。玩家只需放入 prod.keys 和游戏（本体、更新、DLC）。
en: The S2Arm engine, Python and its dependencies, the .NET runtime, compiling tools and shared fonts are all bundled. Compiling games needs full Xcode and its Metal Toolchain (fix with one click next to the check); launching compiled games does not. Just add your prod.keys and games (base, updates, DLC).

source: 与界面语言独立；可在游戏详情中单独设置启动语言。下次启动生效，无需重新编译或导入固件。所选语言需游戏自身支持。
en: Independent of the interface language; set a per-game launch language in game details. Takes effect next launch; no repacking or firmware import needed. The game must support the language.

source: 已编译的游戏可以启动，编译环境还需修复
en: Packed games can launch; the compiling environment still needs fixing

source: S2Arm、Python、.NET 和共享字体随应用内置。编译还需要 Xcode 与 Metal 编译组件，缺了在检测项旁一键处理；玩家只需放入密钥和游戏。
en: S2Arm, Python, .NET and shared fonts are bundled. Compiling also needs Xcode and its Metal Toolchain; fix with one click next to the check. Just add your keys and games.

source: S2Arm 引擎随应用内置，包含 Mac 宿主、NSP/XCI 读取器和游戏编译工具。玩家数据与构建缓存独立保存。
en: The S2Arm engine is bundled: the Mac host, NSP/XCI reader and game compiling tools. Player data and build caches are stored separately.

source: Xcode（编译时需要，自动找到）
en: Xcode (needed for compiling, found automatically)

en: Needed to pack

en: Compiling

source: 编译和运行互斥，请等当前任务结束。
en: Compiling and running can’t happen at the same time. Wait for the current task to finish.

source: 打开后，这台 Mac 上的 AI 助手（比如 Claude Code）可以替你放密钥、放游戏、编译、打 iPhone 包、看失败原因并重试。只在本机，别的设备连不进来。
en: When on, an AI assistant on this Mac (such as Claude Code) can add keys and games, pack, build iPhone packages, read why something failed and retry for you. Local only; other devices cannot connect.

source: 将对应的游戏本体 NSP 或 XCI 一并导入；仅更新或 DLC 不能单独编译。
en: Import the matching base-game NSP or XCI as well. An update or DLC alone cannot be packaged.

source: 重新编译这款游戏以恢复完整运行文件；保留原有存档，编译成功后再启动。
en: Package this game again to restore complete runtime files. Keep your saves, then launch after packaging succeeds.

source: 游戏运行版本链接已失效，请重新编译。
en: The installed game release link is broken. Pack the game again.

source: 运行版本的 NPDM 无效，请重新编译。
en: The installed game has an invalid NPDM. Pack it again.

source: 新版 Mac 宿主可从游戏菜单或菜单栏手柄图标查看本局键位。旧包需重新编译，改键下次启动生效。
en: New Mac hosts show this run's controls from the game menu or menu-bar controller icon. Rebuild old packages; binding changes apply next launch.

source: 开发中：现有构建只出原生目标文件，还没有 HAP 编译
en: In development: the current build only produces native object files; HAP packaging is not available yet

source: iPhone 包已出好。用数据线连上 iPhone，在编译任务页点「装到 iPhone」就能装上（也可以按装机步骤改用 AltStore）。
en: iPhone package ready. Connect your iPhone with a cable and click “Install on iPhone” on the Compiling page (or use AltStore — see the install steps).

source: 启动器出的包是自签的，iPhone 不认，要用你自己的 Apple ID 重新签一次。编译本来就要装 Xcode，用它最省事：
en: The package is self-signed, so iPhone won't accept it until it's signed with your own Apple ID. You already have Xcode for compiling — that's the easiest way:

source: 回到 S2Arm，在编译任务页点「装到 iPhone」：自动签名、安装，并把资源包拷进去、逐个文件核对。
en: Back in S2Arm, click “Install on iPhone” on the Compiling page: it signs, installs, and copies the resource pack, checking every file.

source: 添加的游戏放进来就自动编译，更新和 DLC 自动按版本合并。准备完成后由你点击启动。
en: Added games are prepared automatically; updates and DLC are merged by version. Launch a game when preparation finishes.

source: 编译成功不代表游戏已通过兼容性验证。
en: Successful preparation does not confirm game compatibility.

source: 改完下次启动生效，不用重新编译。
en: Changes take effect on the next launch. No rebuild needed.

source: 版本与你的游戏不同，编译时按特征跨版本定位
en: The version differs from your game. Matching across versions is performed during the build.

source: 宽屏和 60 帧是 S2Arm 自己的能力（从开源社区的补丁里学成的通用规律），按你的游戏版本匹配；匹配不到就自动不用。
en: Widescreen and 60 FPS are S2Arm's own capabilities (general rules learned from open-source community patches), matched to your game version. If no match is found, they are not used.

source: 包里不带社区补丁的原始数据。宽屏和 60 帧在这里（或 iPhone 的 App 设置）开关，下次启动生效，不用重新编译。
en: The build does not include raw community patch data. Toggle widescreen and 60 FPS here (or in the iPhone app settings). Changes take effect on the next launch without rebuilding.

source: 打开「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 文件与文件夹」（外接盘看「可移除的宗卷」），允许本应用读取游戏文件所在位置，或把游戏文件拷到「下载」之外的本机文件夹，然后重试。
en: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders (Removable Volumes for external drives) and allow this app to read the game file's location, or copy the game file to a local folder other than Downloads, then try again.

source: 确认游戏文件所在磁盘已连接、文件没有损坏（换一个位置拷一份再放），然后重试；反馈时复制错误摘要。
en: Make sure the drive holding the game file is connected and the file isn't damaged (copy it to another location and add it again), then try again. Copy the error summary when reporting.

source: 已自动安装 .NET SDK，但复查仍未通过，iPhone 包没有开始出。请在「设置 → 环境检查」查看 .NET 一项的说明，处理后再点「打 iPhone 包」。
en: .NET SDK was installed automatically, but the recheck still fails, so the iPhone package was not started. Open Settings → Environment check, follow the .NET item's instructions, then click “Pack for iPhone” again.

source: iPhone 包已出好。可以用数据线连上 iPhone，在打包任务页点「装到 iPhone」（这条路还在真机验证，装不上请按装机步骤改用 AltStore）。
en: iPhone package ready. You can connect your iPhone with a cable and click “Install on iPhone” on the Packing page (this path is still being verified on real devices; if it fails, use AltStore — see the install steps).

en: Choose an S2Arm backup file, or a JKSV, Checkpoint, yuzu or Ryujinx save folder or zip. A preview appears first, and nothing is restored until you confirm. Restoring replaces the current save, and a backup is made first.

en: Apps signed with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days. When that happens, connect your iPhone and install again; game files already on the phone aren't copied again. You can have up to 3 self-signed apps at a time.

en: On your iPhone, tap Trust and enter your passcode.

source: 在 iPhone 上打开「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」，按提示重启手机；重启后解锁，这里会自动打勾。
en: On your iPhone, turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode and restart when asked. After it restarts, unlock it and this will tick itself.

source: 把提示词粘贴给你常用的 AI，它会按 S2Arm 内置的操作手册替你放密钥、放游戏、导出、装到 iPhone，出问题也会自己排查。你能在这个窗口里看到它的每一步。只在本机，别的设备连不进来。
en: Paste the prompt into the AI assistant you use. Following the operator manual built into S2Arm, it adds your keys and games, exports, installs on your iPhone and troubleshoots problems. You can watch every step in this window. It works only on this Mac; other devices can't connect.

source: 已复制。粘贴给你常用的 AI（Claude、ChatGPT、Codex 等）就行：它会一步步替你操作 S2Arm，遇到只能你本人做的事会停下来告诉你。
en: Copied. Paste it into the AI you use (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and so on). It operates S2Arm step by step and stops to tell you when something needs you.

source: 把提示词粘贴给你常用的 AI，它会替你做完后面的步骤，你在这个窗口里看着就行。
en: Paste the prompt into the AI you use. It does the remaining steps while you watch this window.

source: 导入完成：游戏原件留在原处，S2Arm 只读、不复制。
en: Import finished. Your game files stay where they are; S2Arm only reads them and makes no copies.

source: 工作数据放到这台 Mac 上
en: Keep working data on this Mac

source: 好，用这台 Mac 上的默认位置
en: OK, use the default location on this Mac

source: 这个文件夹在
en: This folder is on a drive formatted as

source: 格式的磁盘上。游戏原件放在这里没问题：放游戏时直接选它们，S2Arm 只读、不复制也不改。导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 APFS 格式的磁盘上，会放到这台 Mac 上的默认位置。想把工作数据也放外接盘，可以在「磁盘工具」里给它另分出一个 APFS 分区（盘上要有空闲空间，原有数据不动），再选那个分区。
en: . Your game files can stay here: pick them when adding games, and S2Arm only reads them without copying or changing them. The working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an APFS drive, so it goes to the default location on this Mac. To keep working data on the external drive too, add an APFS partition to it in Disk Utility (the drive needs free space; existing data stays), then choose that partition.

source: 游戏库放导出时的工作数据和存档，要在 APFS 格式的磁盘上；游戏原件留在原处（哪块盘都行），S2Arm 只读、不复制。
en: The library holds export working data and saves and must be on an APFS drive. Game files stay where they are (any drive); S2Arm only reads them and makes no copies.

source: 游戏原件放哪块盘都行，导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 APFS 格式的磁盘上：在「设置 → 游戏库与玩家数据」改用这台 Mac 上的默认位置（内置盘），或选一块 APFS 格式的外接盘（可在「磁盘工具」里另分出一个 APFS 分区，盘上要有空闲空间、原有数据不动），再重试；游戏原件不用挪。
en: Game files can be on any drive, but the working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an APFS drive. In Settings → Library & Player Data, switch to the default location on this Mac (built-in drive), or choose an APFS external drive (in Disk Utility you can add an APFS partition if the drive has free space; existing data stays), then try again. Your game files don't need to move.

source: 接上游戏原件所在的磁盘，确认文件仍在原位置且可读取；原件挪了位置就把它重新放进来一次。
en: Connect the drive that holds the game file and make sure the file is still in place and readable. If you moved it, add it again from its new location.

source: S2Arm 只读游戏原件、不改不删；同一块盘或文件夹在这台 Mac 上只需允许一次，以后升级 S2Arm 也不用再点。
en: S2Arm only reads your game files and never changes or deletes them. You allow each drive or folder once on this Mac; later S2Arm updates won't ask again.

source: 请改用64位Windows主机运行S2Arm，确认后点「重新检查」。
en: Run S2Arm on a 64-bit Windows computer, then click Recheck.

source: 检查网络后重试；还是不行就到下载页下载新版覆盖安装，当前版本和存档不受影响。
en: Check your network and try again. If it still fails, download the new version from the download page and install it over this one. Your current version and saves are not affected.

source: 这款游戏有一处程序代码暂不支持，建议反馈让我们补上：点「复制错误摘要」并发给我们。
en: This game has a code pattern that is not yet supported. We recommend reporting this: click Copy error summary and send it to us.

source: 这款游戏的着色器编译目前只能在 Mac 上完成，Windows 版暂不支持；请改用 Mac 版 S2Arm 出包。
en: Shader compilation for this game is currently only available on Mac, not yet on Windows. Use S2Arm for Mac to build the package.

source: 从微软官网下载并安装环境清单要求的.NET SDK（https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet），装好后点「重新检查」。
en: Download and install the .NET SDK required by the environment checklist from Microsoft (https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet), then click Recheck.

source: 游戏库在云盘同步目录里（iCloud 云盘、OneDrive、Dropbox 等）：出包时会写几十 GB 中间文件，云盘会上传它们、换成占位文件，出包中途会读不到。在「设置 → 游戏库与玩家数据」把游戏库改到本机磁盘上不同步的位置（例如默认位置），再重试；游戏原件放在哪都行。
en: The game library is inside a cloud-synced folder (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and similar). Exporting writes tens of GB of intermediate files, which the cloud client uploads and replaces with placeholders, so the export cannot read them. In Settings → Library and player data, move the library to a local, non-synced location (such as the default one), then try again. Game files can stay anywhere.

source: 游戏原件放哪块盘都行，导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 NTFS 格式的磁盘上（FAT32 单个文件不能超过 4 GB，exFAT 没有可靠的原子替换）：在「设置 → 游戏库与玩家数据」改用这台电脑上的默认位置，或选一块 NTFS 格式的盘，再重试。
en: Game files can stay on any drive; the working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an NTFS drive (FAT32 cannot hold files over 4 GB, and exFAT has no reliable atomic replace). In Settings → Library and player data, use this PC's default location or choose an NTFS drive, then try again.

source: 还没有登录 Apple ID：打开 Xcode，点菜单 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts，点 + 添加你的 Apple ID（免费的就行），选中账号，等团队列表显示出来，再回来重新检查。装了多个 Xcode 也只要登一个，账号是共用的。
en: You're not signed in to an Apple ID. Open Xcode, choose Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts, click + and add your Apple ID (a free one is fine), select it, wait for the team list to appear, then check again. With several Xcode versions, signing in to one is enough.

source: Apple ID 已经登录，但这台 Mac 还没有签名团队：点「解决办法」打开现成的引导项目，在 Xcode 里选 Personal Team，连上手机点运行一次，回来会自动打勾。也可以先到 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts 看团队列表有没有显示。
en: Your Apple ID is signed in, but this Mac has no signing team yet. Click How to fix to open the ready-made helper project, choose Personal Team in Xcode, connect your phone and run it once; this page updates by itself. You can also check whether the team list appears under Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts.

source: 在装机页点「解决办法」打开引导项目，在 Xcode 里选 Personal Team，连上手机点运行一次，再点一次「装到 iPhone」。也可以先到 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts 看团队列表有没有显示。
en: On the install page, click How to fix to open the helper project, choose Personal Team in Xcode, connect your phone and run it once, then install again. You can also check whether the team list appears under Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts.

source: 打开 Xcode，点菜单 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts，选中账号后点 Manage Certificates，点 + 选 Apple Development，再点一次「装到 iPhone」。
en: Open Xcode, choose Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts, select your account, click Manage Certificates, click + and choose Apple Development, then install again.

source: 找不到游戏原件：{0}。原件所在的磁盘没接上，或文件被挪走 / 改名了；接上磁盘，或把原件重新放进来一次
en: Original game file not found: {0}. Its drive is not connected, or the file was moved or renamed. Connect the drive, or add the original file again

source: 找签名账号与 iPhone
en: Finding signing account and iPhone

source: 备份这款的存档
en: Backing up saves for this game

source: 更新手机上的 S2Arm
en: Updating S2Arm on iPhone

source: 删除手机上这款的数据
en: Removing this game's data from iPhone

source: 手机上的 S2Arm 里没有这款。
en: This game is not in S2Arm on your iPhone.

source: 这是手机上最后一款：在 iPhone 桌面长按 S2Arm 删除 App 即可。
en: This is the last game on iPhone: long-press S2Arm on the home screen and delete the app instead.

source: 这台电脑没记录手机上的 S2Arm：先装一次再删。
en: No S2Arm install record on this computer: install once before removing a game.

source: App 里这款已经删了，但手机上它的数据没删掉：
en: The game was removed from the app, but its data on iPhone could not be deleted:

source: 先给点名的游戏各「打 iPhone 包」一次，再装到 iPhone；手机上现有的游戏不受影响。
en: Run "Build for iPhone" once for each game named, then install on iPhone; the games already on your phone are not affected.

source: 这款没法和手机上已有的游戏放进同一个 App：先从 iPhone 删掉不兼容的那款。
en: This game cannot share one app with the games already on your phone: remove the incompatible game from iPhone first.

source: 在 iPhone 桌面长按 S2Arm 删除 App 即可。
en: Touch and hold S2Arm on the iPhone Home Screen and remove the app.

source: 手机解锁、数据线插稳后再删一次；不影响其他游戏。
en: Unlock the phone, check the cable, and remove it again; other games are not affected.

source: 在这台 Mac 屏幕上的钥匙串弹窗里点「始终允许」（需要的话输入 Mac 登录密码），再点一次「装到 iPhone」。
en: In the keychain prompt on this Mac's screen, click "Always Allow" (enter your Mac login password if asked), then install on iPhone again.

source: 路径太长：把游戏库搬到盘符根目录附近的短路径（比如 D:\S2Arm），再打一次包；反馈时请带上错误摘要。
en: Path too long: move your game library to a short path near the drive root (for example D:\S2Arm), then build again. Include the error summary when reporting.

source: 检查文件和票据是否完整；若另行确认 Switch 密钥版本不足，可重新导出并到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入。
en: Check that the file and its tickets are complete. If you independently confirm your Switch keys are outdated, export them again and add them in Settings → Player keys.

source: 从原始位置重新复制完整的游戏文件，再重新导入。
en: Copy the complete game file from its original location and import it again.

source: 用系统版本更新的 Switch 重新导出 prod.keys，再到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入。
en: Export prod.keys from a Switch with newer system software, then add the file again in Settings → Player keys.

source: 游戏文件不完整，部分内容超出文件末尾。
en: The game file is incomplete. Some content extends past the end of the file.

source: 缺少内容对应的票据或标题密钥，请检查源文件是否完整。
en: The content's ticket or title key is missing. Check that the source file is complete.

source: 核对源文件是否含有所需票据。
en: Check whether the source file includes the required ticket.

source: 现有 prod.keys 缺少读取此文件所需的密钥。
en: Your prod.keys file is missing keys needed to read this file.

source: 无法读取游戏内容：可能是文件不完整、缺票据或密钥不匹配。请核对原始文件；若已确认 Switch 密钥版本不足，再重新导出，到「设置 → 玩家密钥」重新导入。
en: Could not read the game content. The file might be incomplete, a ticket may be missing, or the keys may not match. Check the original file. If you have confirmed the Switch keys are outdated, export them again and add them in Settings → Player keys.

source: 读不到设备列表：打开一次 Xcode，等它装完附加组件后再试。
en: Can't read the device list. Open Xcode once, wait for its additional components to install, then try again.

source: 同一网络上有多台配对过的 iPhone / iPad：用数据线连上要装的那一台。
en: Several paired iPhones / iPads are on this network. Connect the one you want to install on with a cable.

source: 读取设备列表超时：解锁手机，重新插一次数据线再试。
en: Reading the device list timed out. Unlock the phone, plug the cable in again and retry.

source: 这台 Mac 的 USB 上没看到 iPhone / iPad：换一根能传数据的线（充电线不行）、换个接口直连 Mac，并解锁手机。
en: This Mac doesn't see an iPhone / iPad on USB. Use a cable that carries data (a charge-only cable won't work), plug directly into the Mac, and unlock the phone.

source: 这台 Mac 看到手机插着，但设备服务还没列出它：解锁手机，在弹出的框里点「信任」；还不行就拔掉重插一次。
en: This Mac sees a phone plugged in, but the device service hasn't listed it yet. Unlock the phone and tap Trust. If that fails, unplug it and plug it in again.

source: 之前选的设备「{0}」现在不在，可选：{1}。用数据线只连要装的那一台再试。
en: The device you chose before, "{0}", isn't available. Available: {1}. Connect only the one you want with a cable and try again.

source: 和手机建立开发连接失败：解锁手机后再试；走无线的话换成数据线。
en: Couldn't open a development connection to the phone. Unlock it and try again. If it's on Wi-Fi, use a cable.

source: 手机的开发者服务没准备好：解锁手机后再试；还不行就重启手机。
en: The phone's developer services aren't ready. Unlock it and try again. If that fails, restart the phone.

source: iPhone 已准备好安装
en: iPhone is ready to install

source: 正在请手机信任这台 Mac
en: Asking the phone to trust this Mac

source: 正在和手机建立开发连接
en: Opening a development connection to the phone

source: 正在准备手机的开发者服务
en: Preparing the phone's developer services

source: 手机还没准备好
en: iPhone isn't ready

source: 按上面的提示做完，再点一次安装。
en: Follow the steps above, then tap Install again.
